remarks: ***Highest and Best Offers Requested by Monday 4/21 by 5PM*** Tucked away in a peaceful residential neighborhood, this charming townhouse offers 2 spacious bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms in a quiet, well-maintained complex. Perched on a hill, the home features beautiful views from the eat-in kitchen and the private back deck, accessed through sliding glass doors-perfect for enjoying morning coffee or evening sunsets. The finished lower level includes a walkout to a secluded patio, ideal for relaxing or entertaining, along with a separate laundry area and direct access to the attached garage. With ample visitor parking and access to the community pool, this home combines comfort, convenience, and a serene setting.
